verdict.rationale: Algolia ships official open-source UI libraries, InstantSearch.js and React InstantSearch, with predefined widgets you can configure and style with CSS, extend, or replace with custom widgets. A refinementList widget handles facets, and the quickstart builds a React app that searches, filters by product type and paginates. A hands-on community user calls React InstantSearch great and easy to add, and another says DocSearch 'just works' from a JS include and an input. missing for 10: explicit documentation in the pack of dedicated search box, hits/results and pagination widgets (they are only implied by the quickstart description).
